subject: Important Update: Upcoming Changes to Company Policy
body: Dear Team, I hope this message finds you well. I wanted to inform you about some upcoming changes to our company policy regarding remote work. We will be implementing a hybrid work model starting next month to increase flexibility while maintaining productivity. Please review the updated policy document attached to this email for more details. If you have any questions or concerns, feel free to reach out to me. Thank you for your cooperation. Best regards, [Your Name]
